independence_limitation: Audited in all_historical_holdouts_overlap_audit.json: the union of all 18 historical holdouts covers 67,007 of 70,000 train rows (95.72%). Although `disjoint_3seed_20261101` was constructed to have 0.0% overlap with the recent confirm sets of 2026, 314159, and 20261030, it overlaps in 53.49% with their tune+confirm union and in 92.39% (8,862 / 9,592) with the union of all 18 historical holdouts. Sharing fit rows across experiments does not constitute supervised leakage, but does rule out sample independence. All 3 cuts execute strictly inductive per-fold vocabulary and TF-IDF refit inside `fit`.
transportability_assumptions: 1. Conditional invariance within strata: E[Delta Acc | seen/new, test] == E[Delta Acc | seen/new, confirm].
2. Mixture reweighting: Validation confirm has ~30.2% seen / ~69.8% new rows, whereas Kaggle 30k test has 71.623% seen (21,487) / 28.377% new (8,513) rows.
3. Sample size scaling: Full 70k refit has 58% more training rows than the ~44.2k `fit` split, strengthening seen-seller target encodings.

4. Threshold sensitivity: Thresholds tuned on a 30/70 seen/new validation mixture can suffer prior-shift degradation on a 72/28 test mixture; common-threshold (0.500) comparisons isolate pure probability ranking improvements.
